verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.pt: Palavra que veio a Jeremias quanto a todo o povo de Judá, no quarto ano de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, (o qual é o primeiro ano de Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia);
verses.en_web: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (the same was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),
verses.en_bbe: The word which came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah king of Judah; this was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon.

verses.en: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.pt: A qual o profeta Jeremias falou a todo o povo de Judá, e a todos os moradores de Jerusalém, dizendo:
verses.en_web: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:
verses.en_bbe: This word Jeremiah gave out to all the people of Judah and to those living in Jerusalem, saying,

verses.en: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
verses.pt: Desde o ano treze de Josias, filho de Amom, rei de Judá, até este dia, isto é, há vinte e três anos, tem vindo a mim a palavra do SENHOR; e eu tenho vos falado, insistentemente vos falando; porém vós não escutastes.
verses.en_web: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, Yahweh’s word has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.
verses.en_bbe: From the thirteenth year of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah, even till this day, for twenty-three years, the word of the Lord has been coming to me, and I have given it to you, getting up early and talking to you; but you have not given ear.

verses.en: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR enviou a vós todos seus servos os profetas, insistentemente os enviando; porém vos não escutastes, nem inclinastes vossos ouvidos para escutar,
verses.en_web: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear),
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord has sent to you all his servants the prophets, getting up early and sending them; but you have not given attention and your ear has not been open to give hearing;

verses.en: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.pt: Quando diziam: Convertei-vos agora, cada um de seu mau caminho, e da maldade de vossas ações, e habitai na terra que o SENHOR deu a vós e a vossos pais para todo o sempre;
verses.en_web: saying, “Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forever more.
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Come back now, everyone from his evil way and from the evil of your doings, and keep your place in the land which the Lord has given to you and to your fathers, from times long past even for ever:

verses.en: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.pt: E não segui deuses estrangeiros, para os servirdes e encurvardes a eles, nem me provoqueis à ira com a obra de vossas mãos; para que eu não vos faça mal.
verses.en_web: Don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; then I will do you no harm.”
verses.en_bbe: Do not go after other gods to be their servants and to give them worship, and do not make me angry with the work of your hands, causing evil to yourselves.

verses.en: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.pt: Porém vós não me destes ouvidos, diz o SENHOR, para me provocardes à ira com a obra de vossas mãos, para o vosso mal.
verses.en_web: “Yet you have not listened to me,” says Yahweh; “that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.”
verses.en_bbe: But you have not given ear to me, says the Lord; so that you have made me angry with the work of your hands, causing evil to yourselves.

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
verses.pt: Portanto assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Visto quanto não tendes ouvido minhas palavras,
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh of Armies says: “Because you have not heard my words,
verses.en_bbe: So this is what the Lord of armies has said: Because you have not given ear to my words,

verses.en: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.pt: Eis que eu enviarei, e tomarei a todas as famílias do norte, diz o SENHOR, e a Nabucodonosor rei de Babilônia, meu servo, e os trarei contra esta terra, e contra seus moradores, e contra todas estas nações ao redor; e os destruirei, e os farei de espanto, assovio, e de desolações perpétuas.
verses.en_web: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north,” says Yahweh, “and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around. I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.en_bbe: See, I will send and take all the families of the north, says the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, my servant, and make them come against this land, and against its people, and against all these nations on every side; and I will give them up to complete destruction, and make them a cause of fear and surprise and a waste place for ever.

verses.en: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.pt: E eliminarei dentre eles a voz de júbilo e voz de alegria, voz de noivo e voz de noiva, o ruído das pedras de moer, e a luz de lâmpada.
verses.en_web: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
verses.en_bbe: And more than this, I will take from them the sound of laughing voices, the voice of joy, the voice of the newly-married man, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the stones crushing the grain, and the shining of lights.

verses.en: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.pt: E toda esta terra se tornará em desolação, e em espanto; e estas nações servirão ao rei da Babilônia por setenta anos.
verses.en_web: This whole land will be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.en_bbe: All this land will be a waste and a cause of wonder; and these nations will be the servants of the king of Babylon for seventy years.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.pt: E será que, quando os setenta anos forem completados, punirei ao rei da Babilônia e àquela nação por sua maldade, diz o SENHOR, assim como a terra dos Caldeus; e a tornarei em desolações para sempre.
verses.en_web: “It will happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,” says Yahweh, “for their iniquity. I will make the land of the Chaldeans desolate forever.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about, after seventy years are ended, that I will send punishment on the king of Babylon, and on that nation, says the Lord, for their evil-doing, and on the land of the Chaldaeans; and I will make it a waste for ever.

verses.en: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
verses.pt: E trarei sobre aquela terra todas as minhas palavras que falado contra ela: tudo o que está escrito neste livro, que Jeremias profetizou contra todas as nações.
verses.en_web: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make that land undergo everything I have said against it, even everything recorded in this book, which Jeremiah the prophet has said against all the nations.

verses.en: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.pt: Porque também deles se servirão muitas nações e grandes reis; assim lhes pagarei conforme seus feitos, conforme a obra de suas mãos.
verses.en_web: For many nations and great kings will make bondservants of them, even of them. I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.”
verses.en_bbe: For a number of nations and great kings will make servants of them, even of them: and I will give them the reward of their acts, even the reward of the work of their hands.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
verses.pt: Porque assim me disse o SENHOR Deus de Israel: Toma de minha mão este copo de vinho do meu furor, e dá de beber dele a todas as nações às quais eu te envio.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations to whom I send you to drink it.
verses.en_bbe: For this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said to me: Take the cup of the wine of this wrath from my hand, and make all the nations to whom I send you take of it.

verses.en: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.pt: E beberão, tremerão, e enlouquecerão, por causa da espada que eu envio entre eles.
verses.en_web: They will drink, and reel back and forth, and be insane, because of the sword that I will send among them.”
verses.en_bbe: And after drinking it, they will go rolling from side to side, and be off their heads, because of the sword which I will send among them.

verses.en: Then took I the cup at the LORD’S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
verses.pt: E eu tomei o copo da mão do SENHOR, e dei de beber a todas as nações às quais o SENHOR tinha me enviado:
verses.en_web: Then took I the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:
verses.en_bbe: Then I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and gave a drink from it to all the nations to whom the Lord sent me;

verses.en: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
verses.pt: A Jerusalém, às cidades de Judá; e a seus reis e seus príncipes, para torná-los em desolação, em espanto, em assovio, e em maldição, tal como é hoje;
verses.en_web: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, with its kings and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is today;
verses.en_bbe: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah and their kings and their princes, to make them a waste place, a cause of fear and surprise and a curse, as it is this day;

verses.en: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
verses.pt: A Faraó rei do Egito, e a seus servos, seus príncipes, e a todo o seu povo;
verses.en_web: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;
verses.en_bbe: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and his servants and his princes and all his people;

verses.en: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
verses.pt: E a todas os povos ali misturados; e a todos os reis da terra de Uz, e a todos os reis da terra dos filisteus, e a Asquelom, Gaza, e Ecrom; e aos restantes de Asdode;
verses.en_web: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
verses.en_bbe: And all the mixed people and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon and Gaza and Ekron and the rest of Ashdod;

verses.en: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
verses.pt: A Edom, Moabe, e aos filhos de Amom;
verses.en_web: Edom, Moab, and the children of Ammon;
verses.en_bbe: Edom and Moab and the children of Ammon,

verses.en: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
verses.pt: E a todos os reis de Tiro, e a todos os reis da Sidom, e aos reis dos litorais que estão além do mar;
verses.en_web: and all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;
verses.en_bbe: And all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the lands across the sea;

verses.en: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
verses.pt: E a Dedã, e Tema, e Buz, e a todos os dos cantos mais distantes.
verses.en_web: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;
verses.en_bbe: Dedan and Tema and Buz, and all who have the ends of their hair cut;

verses.en: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
verses.pt: E a todos os reis de Arábia, e a todos os reis dos povos misturados que habitam no deserto;
verses.en_web: and all the kings of Arabia, all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;
verses.en_bbe: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people living in the waste land;

verses.en: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
verses.pt: E a todos os reis de Zinri, e a todos os reis de Elão, e a todos os reis de Média;
verses.en_web: and all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
verses.en_bbe: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

verses.en: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
verses.pt: E a todos os reis do norte, os de perto e os de longe, tanto uns como os outros; e a todos os reinos da terra que estão sobre a face da terra; e o rei de Sesaque beberá depois deles.
verses.en_web: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.
verses.en_bbe: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
verses.pt: Pois tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Bebei, e embriagai-vos, vomitai, caí, e não vos levanteis, por causa da espada que eu envio entre vós.
verses.en_web: “You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.”’
verses.en_bbe: And you are to say to them, This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: Take of this cup and be overcome, and let it come out again from your lips, and from your fall you will never be lifted up again, because of the sword which I will send among you.

verses.en: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
verses.pt: E será que, se não querem tomar o copo de tua mão para beber, então tu lhes dirás: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Certamente bebereis;
verses.en_web: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “You shall surely drink.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be, if they will not take of the cup in your hand, then you are to say to them, This is what the Lord of armies has said: You will certainly take of it.

verses.en: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: Pois eis que na cidade que se chama pelo meu nome eu começo a castigar; e vós ficaríeis impunes? Não ficareis impunes, porque eu estou chamando espada contra todos os moradores da terra, diz o SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You will not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.”’
verses.en_bbe: For see, I am starting to send evil on the town which is named by my name, and are you to be without any punishment? You will not be without punishment: for I will send a sword on all people living on the earth, says the Lord of armies.

verses.en: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.pt: Tu, pois, profetizarás a eles todas estas palavras, e lhes dirás: O SENHOR bramará desde o alto, e levantará sua voz a sua santa morada; bramará intensamente sobre sua morada; dará forte grito, tal como os que pisam as uvas, contra todos os moradores da terra.
verses.en_web: “Therefore prophesy against them all these words, and tell them, “‘Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation. He will mightily roar against his fold. He will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: So, as a prophet, give out these words among them, and say to them, The voice of the Lord will be sounding like a lion from on high; he will send out his voice from his holy place, like the loud voice of a lion, against his flock; he will give a cry, like those who are crushing the grapes, against all the people of the earth.

verses.en: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: Chegará o estrondo até o extremo da terra; porque o SENHOR disputa com as nações; entrará em juízo com todos; e entregará os perversos à espada, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: A noise will come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations. He will enter into judgment with all flesh. As for the wicked, he will give them to the sword,”’ says Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: A noise will come, even to the end of the earth; for the Lord has a cause against the nations, he will give his decision against all flesh; as for the evil-doers, he will give them to the sword, says the Lord.

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.pt: Assim diz o SENHOR dos exércitos: Eis que a calamidade sai de nação em nação, e uma grande tempestade se levantará desde os confins da terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh of Armies says, “Behold, evil will go out from nation to nation, and a great storm will be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord of armies has said: See, evil is going out from nation to nation, and a great storm will come up from the inmost parts of the earth.

verses.en: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
verses.pt: E os mortos pelo SENHOR naquele dia serão desde um extremo da terra até o outro extremo; não serão lamentados, nem recolhidos, nem sepultados; serão como esterco sobre a face da terra.
verses.en_web: The slain of Yahweh will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.
verses.en_bbe: And at that day, the bodies of those whom the Lord has put to death will be seen from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: there will be no weeping for them, their bodies will not be taken up or put to rest in the earth; they will be like waste on the face of the land.

verses.en: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
verses.pt: Uivai, pastores, e clamai; e revolvei-vos na cinza, líderes do rebanho; porque já se cumpriram vossos dias para serdes mortos; e sereis dispersos e caireis como um vaso precioso.
verses.en_web: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions have fully come, and you will fall like fine pottery.
verses.en_bbe: Give cries of grief, you keepers of sheep; give cries for help, rolling yourselves in the dust, you chiefs of the flock: for the days of your destruction have fully come, and I will send you in all directions, and your fall will be like that of the males of the flock.

verses.en: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
verses.pt: E não haverá meio de fuga para os pastores, nem escape para os líderes do rebanho.
verses.en_web: The shepherds will have no way to flee. The leader of the flock will have no escape.
verses.en_bbe: There will be no way of flight for the keepers of sheep, no road for the chiefs of the flock to get away safely.

verses.en: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
verses.pt: Haverá voz do grito dos pastores, e uivo dos lideres do rebanho; porque o SENHOR assolou os seus pastos.
verses.en_web: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for Yahweh destroys their pasture.
verses.en_bbe: A sound of the cry of the keepers of sheep, and the bitter crying of the chiefs of the flock! for the Lord has made waste their green fields.

verses.en: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
verses.pt: E as pastagens quietas serão devastadas por causa do furor da ira do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And there is no sound in the fields of peace, because of the burning wrath of the Lord.

verses.en: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.pt: Ele deixou seu abrigo tal como filhote de leão; pois assolada foi a terra deles, pelo furor do opressor, e pelo furor de sua ira.
verses.en_web: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.
verses.en_bbe: The lion has come out of his secret place, for the land has become a waste because of the cruel sword, and because of the heat of his wrath.
